result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping text in the metadata line under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, where the delivery time and delivery fee render on top of each other.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') overlap each other, producing garbled text that reads like '25–3€0 mieliivery'. The information is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the metadata row so each text element occupies its own space (e.g., use a horizontal flex/stack layout with spacing and separator dots instead of absolute positioning), ensuring 'time • fee • cuisine' render sequentially without overlap.
